work.ibm-consulting-light.v1.name: IBM Consulting light — preference preset
work.ibm-consulting-light.v1.basis: user preference; authored seed, not an official brand specification

tokens.font_preference: IBM Plex Sans when installed; otherwise disclose substitution
tokens.layout: 16:9 for slides; generous margins; clear grid; strong left alignment; restrained blue accents
tokens.graphics: clean technical linework; authentic supplied logos only; avoid decorative clutter
tokens.text: short hierarchical blocks; exact requested strings; ample line spacing

guardrails: No claim of official brand compliance without actual template
Preserve approved narrative and slide order

work.ibm-template-exact.v1.name: Bound IBM template

tokens.layout: Use bound template geometry, typography, backgrounds and actual reference renders
tokens.text: Preserve exact copy and specified object positions
tokens.graphics: Use supplied authentic assets; mark unresolved assets

guardrails: Do not claim pixel-perfect matching from a template name alone
Attach reference slide PNGs for visual guidance
Do not substitute another campaign version silently

personal.fiber-glass.v1.name: Fiber & Glass
personal.fiber-glass.v1.basis: prior project preference; opt-in, not universal personal default

tokens.surfaces: tactile fabric-like grounding; opaque readable content; restrained translucent glass accents
tokens.layout: progressive disclosure; calm hierarchy; rounded tactile components
tokens.graphics: warm material depth, not glossy science-fiction chrome
tokens.accessibility: readable contrast and clear non-color state indicators

guardrails: Do not apply this profile to unrelated personal projects without selection

personal.editorial-neutral.v1.name: Personal editorial neutral

tokens.layout: spacious editorial hierarchy with legible headings

guardrails: Override explicitly for book, app or themed project styles

technical.diagram-clean.v1.name: Clean technical diagram

tokens.layout: orthogonal connectors; consistent node geometry; visible arrowheads; avoid crossing lines
tokens.graphics: flat or subtle depth; uniform line weight
tokens.text: short exact node labels; relationships from supplied topology

guardrails: Never invent edges or quantities for aesthetics
Icons default to no text; transparency must be actual alpha

custom.inline.v1.name: Inline custom design
guardrails: Provide concrete palette, composition and typography/linework instructions in overrides
